service.description: An organization's return policies (ReturnPolicyList), the most specific first, each with its conditions, rank, window, authorization days, reasons, remedies, fee and state (Draft, Scheduled, In effect, Ended: with includeEnded only), and its current return reason rows (ReturnReasons). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, RETURN_AUTHORIZE, RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE or RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

A return policy row (ReturnPolicyEdit): new, from a date (now when not given) or as a draft (no from date); a draft changed or published; a published row replaced from a date (the new row names it, previousPolicyId, and it ends there); or ended (end). Its conditions: a store of the organization (STORE_UNAVAILABLE), a customer group (CLASSIFICATION_UNKNOWN), a product category (CATEGORY_UNKNOWN); its destination one of the organization's facilities (FACILITY_UNAVAILABLE); its reasons, remedies and window start of their types and its days whole numbers above zero (VALUE_INVALID, WINDOW_INVALID). A field not passed keeps the row's. Refuses a published row with the same conditions as another over the same dates (EQUAL_RANK_OVERLAP). A return keeps the row it was evaluated against. Needs RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

An organization's row for a return reason (ReturnReasons): the customer's label, whether customers may choose it, whether evidence is required, the suggested response and whether the goods are inspected, from a date (now), ending the reason's current row; end ends it. Refuses a value not of its type (VALUE_INVALID). Needs RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

The policy preview of NewReturn and ReturnPolicyPreview, changing nothing: a sale's product lines (or the given lines: orderItemSeqId or, for goods with no order line, productId, with quantity, returnReasonEnumId and returnResponseEnumId), or a return's lines (returnId), each with what was ordered, shipped, invoiced and is on other returns not cancelled (drafts included), what is left (eligibleQuantity), its policy row, the window's end and its exceptions (UNREFERENCED, OUTSIDE_WINDOW, REASON_NOT_ALLOWED, RESPONSE_NOT_ALLOWED); the return's policy, the expiry an authorization now would have, the fee (none without a published rule), the instructions and the outcome: Eligible, ManualReview (no policy: a person decides), ExceptionRequired (a manager approves first) or NotEligible. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, RETURN_AUTHORIZE, RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE or RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the sale's or return's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: A line of an open customer return (ReturnableLines, F21): a line of the sale added (orderId, orderItemSeqId), changed (returnItemSeqId: its quantity, reason or remedy; a new quantity makes the line again so its adjustments are prorated again) or removed (quantity 0), under a lock on the return and the source order line, within what the line has left (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE: shipped and invoiced less every other return not cancelled, drafts included); goods with no order line need a product, a quantity and a description of the goods and the customer's ownership (PRODUCT_REQUIRED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED), and a manager's exception before authorization. Refuses a return no longer open (RETURN_NOT_OPEN), a sale of another customer (ORDER_MISMATCH), no reason or remedy (REASON_REQUIRED, RESPONSE_REQUIRED). Customer Service writes return lines only through it. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE and the return's organization.

The person who follows a customer return: a dated ReturnParty row in the Assignee role, the current one ended (F24); empty unassigns. The assignee works for the return's organization (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE and the return's organization.

A customer's return entered for them (NewReturn's ReturnRequest; design §5): from a sale (orderId, a new return) or an open return (returnId), its lines (lineList: orderItemSeqId or productId, quantity, returnReasonEnumId, returnResponseEnumId, description) saved through save#ReturnItem's check, its policy evaluated and kept on the return (returnPolicyId, policyEvaluatedDate, manualReview) with the customer's reference, the policy's destination facility, the case linked (requestId, link#RequestRecord on ReturnHeader, F47) and the assignee (the user unless given); requested (request#Return) unless draft. An exception the policy needs is sent to the exception approvers (ReturnExceptionApproval). Refuses no lines (RETURN_EMPTY) and more than is left (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE). The same operationKey answers the first result. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE and the organization.

parameter.name: carrierPartyId
parameter.description: The return label's carrier, when not the order's

service.description: The return authorizer's authorization of an open customer return (D11; design ReturnDetail Authorize), at its revision when one is given (STALE_REVISION naming the current one): its lines checked again under their locks (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE), its exceptions approved at this revision first (EXCEPTION_REQUIRED), with no policy a reason (REASON_REQUIRED: manual review); every item's responseImmediate N, unless immediate is asked for, the policy allows instant credit or advance replacement and the actor holds RECEIVABLE_EDIT for a credit or replacement (and PAYMENT_EDIT for a refund); the authorization's expiry from the policy (30 days without one); then Mantle's approve#Return, whose ReturnApprovedProcess makes the return shipment: no settlement here. The decision is recorded (ReturnAuthorizationDecision), the RMA's PDF stored as ReturnContent (RtcntAuthorization; a render failure is logged and the authorization stands) and the assignee told (ReturnDecision). An authorized return answers ALREADY_AUTHORIZED; a closed one is refused (RETURN_CLOSED), one with no lines too (RETURN_EMPTY). The same operationKey answers the first result. Needs RETURN_AUTHORIZE and the return's organization.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode AUTHORIZED or ALREADY_AUTHORIZED, returnId, statusId, shipmentId (the return shipment), expireText, immediateItems, returnContentId (the RMA), the decision and the revision decided.

service.description: An exception asked for on an open customer return (outside the window, a reason or remedy the policy does not allow, goods with no order line), at its current revision: the request recorded and the approvers told (ReturnExceptionApproval: holders of RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE who work for the organization, in the policy's exception group when it names one). Refuses a return needing none (NO_EXCEPTION). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE.

A manager's decision on an open customer return's exceptions (design Approvals; CX-APPROVAL on Purchasing's decision pattern, F45): approve or refuse (a refusal needs a reason, REASON_REQUIRED) at the return's revision; a stale one is refused naming the current revision (STALE_REVISION); a return needing none is refused (NO_EXCEPTION). The decision is recorded, the approvers' notices read and the assignee told. Needs RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE and the return's organization.

The approve service of the ReturnExceptionApproval topic, which the framework's approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user: decide#ReturnException at the revision in the message (sourceRevision); a message with none is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED, F46), another record too (SOURCE_INVALID). Requires RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE.

The refuse service of the ReturnExceptionApproval topic, with the reason: decide#ReturnException refused at the revision in the message; refuses as approve#ReturnException does. Requires RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE.

A customer return cancelled before any physical or financial effect (design ReturnDetail): refuses one with goods received, a credit, a refund or a replacement, or past authorization (RETURN_HAS_EFFECT); an authorized one needs a reason (REASON_REQUIRED). Mantle's cancel#Return cancels its items and its return shipment (F22). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE for an open return, RETURN_AUTHORIZE for an authorized one.

What will not come back of an authorized customer return (design ReturnDetail Receipt), closed with a reason (REASON_REQUIRED): each waiting item (or the one given) authorizes what was received and is Received, or is cancelled when nothing came; its shipment sources stop waiting, the return is Received when every item is, and a return shipment with nothing left to come is delivered (or cancelled with nothing received). Refuses a return waiting for no goods (RETURN_NOT_AWAITING, NOTHING_TO_CLOSE). The decision is recorded. Needs RETURN_AUTHORIZE.

The customer returns of the user's organizations (design Returns ReturnFind and ReturnList), newest first, by view (requested, awaiting, authorized, received, manual, settlement, expiring, cancelled, closed, all), status, customer (or a list of them), order, assignee, text (the return, its RMA number, the customer's reference) and entry period: each with its RMA number, customer reference, order, assignee, expiry, quantities authorized, received, accepted, rejected and settled, status, policy, manual review and exception waiting; the credited amount only for a holder of PRICE_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_VIEW or RECEIVABLE_VIEW (amountsWithheld otherwise). A page at a time. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, RETURN_AUTHORIZE, RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE or RETURN_POLICY_EDIT.

service.description: Home's Returns awaiting approval (design Home AwaitingReturns): the requested customer returns of the user's organizations, the oldest first, each with the expiry an authorization now would have, its policy outcome and the exception waiting. Needs RETURN_AUTHORIZE or RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE.

ReturnDetail's policy part of a customer return: its row (as find#ServiceReturns), its policy evaluation, its decisions (newest first, each marked current when bound to its revision), its revision, whether an exception is approved at it, its effects (what a cancel can no longer undo) and its stored RMA. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, RETURN_AUTHORIZE, RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE or RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the return's organization.

service.description: An authorized customer return's RMA as the customer reads it (html-print and the stored PDF): what to send back, why and by when, where to, the label's tracking and the policy's instructions; no amount. Refuses a return not authorized (RETURN_NOT_AUTHORIZED). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, RETURN_AUTHORIZE, RETURN_EXCEPTION_APPROVE or RETURN_POLICY_EDIT and the return's organization.

The stored RMA (stored now if it is not) mailed to a checked recipient, an address of the customer or of a current contact, employee or representative of it (RECIPIENT_REQUIRED, RECIPIENT_UNCHECKED), with the expiry, the note and a link when given (the Support app's RMA page), as a mail client draft of an account the user sends from (SEND_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED) sent through send#EmailDraft and filed on the return. Refuses a return not authorized (RETURN_NOT_AUTHORIZED). The same operationKey answers the first result. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT or RETURN_AUTHORIZE and the return's organization.
